summary: A sharp sell-off in chip and AI stocks on Thursday wiped out early gains: the Philadelphia chip index fell 6.7% and the Nasdaq had its worst day since early June, as doubts about AI spending came back after Meta's results. On Friday, rising oil prices weighed on stocks after attacks in Saudi Arabia, while energy shares hit a record. Money moved out of tech and into energy, health care and small companies, so the Dow finished up for a third straight week.
